harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1’s staged projects directory as the authenticated, writable SMB share “projects”. Node2 can list, read, and update files as designer. Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected. Both nodes retained Ubuntu 7.10/kernel 2.6.22-14-generic and passed sequential reboot-persistence checks.
actions_performed: Installed legacy-compatible Samba 3.0.26a packages without upgrading the OS or kernel.
Created the designer Samba account using access.txt without exposing credentials.
Restricted the share to the design group and disabled guest access and symlink traversal.
Preserved drawing.txt and materials.csv; added designer-update.txt as the update demonstration.
Corrected a legacy DHCP/Samba boot-order issue and verified automatic recovery through a final node1 reboot.
Restarted nodes sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovered operation.

evidence.requirement: Share named projects exports only the staged projects directory
evidence.summary: Effective configuration maps projects to /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects, requires @design, permits writes, and disables symlink traversal.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can list and read documents as designer
evidence.summary: Authenticated listing and drawing download succeeded; downloaded content matched the staged copy before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can update documents as designer
evidence.summary: Node2 overwrote designer-update.txt and verified the returned content byte-for-byte, including after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected
evidence.summary: Guest access returned NT_STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED; the sibling private share and path traversal were rejected.
Initial and final SHA-256 hashes for drawing.txt and materials.csv are identical.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
Captured healthy local and remote baselines, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered Samba listeners/configuration/data, authenticated reads, and continued guest denial.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change, preserved client/data state, and successful post-restart list/read/update and denial tests.
